roleTitle: Data Quality Engineer, Logistics Delivery Services
jobDescription: The logistics delivery services division of a parcel carrier depends on scan-event data from depots and drivers for tracking and partner settlement. The Data Quality Engineer owns the scan-event data quality programme end-to-end, decides which quality rules are enforced at ingestion, leads the weekly data quality review with depot operations, and is accountable to the head of data for the quality of settlement inputs.
requirements: Owns the scan-event data quality programme end-to-end and decides which quality rules are enforced at ingestion.
Builds and maintains the quality-rule engine and the quality dashboards for scan events.
Leads the weekly data quality review with depot operations and records decisions.
Coordinates rule changes with the settlement and platform teams and records own responsibility boundaries.
Documents rule definitions, known limitations and hand-over conditions for each rule release.

evidence.text: Owned the scan-event data quality programme for the delivery division for two and a half years, deciding which quality rules were enforced at ingestion as the programme's named owner in the data governance register, and switching rules between warn and block modes under my own authority.
Built and maintained the quality-rule engine (Python rules evaluated in the ingestion pipeline) and the quality dashboards showing rule breaches per depot and driver app version.
Led the weekly data quality review with depot operations, deciding which breaches were escalated to depot managers and recording the decisions in the review log.

Coordinated rule changes with the settlement and platform teams through the data change process, recording that the settlement team owned the settlement calculation and the platform team owned the ingestion pipeline while I owned the rules.
Responsibilities included programme ownership, rule decisions, rule-engine development, dashboards and the weekly quality review for scan-event data over about two and a half years.

Work sample: the data governance register entry naming the candidate as programme owner, the rule change log showing mode switches under the candidate's user id and one weekly review log, with the pipeline's rule-release identifiers as a verification trail.
Reference call with the former head of data: confirmed the candidate was the registered programme owner, decided rule enforcement and led the weekly review; confirmed employment dates.
Recruiter logistics note: candidate can attend a rule-engine walkthrough next week; notice period is one month.

gold.expectedGap: Hand-over conditions for each rule release are only partly documented in the change log.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the ownership as documented for the quality rules; do not extend it to the settlement calculation or the ingestion pipeline, which other teams owned.
